jobs.occupation: Tax specialist - Brussels - International Retail Company
jobs.description:
Our client is an international player and global leader in the retail sector with a strong branding and unique company culture. They are currently expanding and reorganizing their finance team to adapt their strategy to the current market.

Jobomschrijving

As a Tax Specialist your function will be twofold. On one side reporting to the accounting manager for the Belgian HQ as well as to the CFO of the e-commerce marketplace.

Belgian HQ:

• Manage monthly VAT filings (BE, FR & LUX)
• Intrastat and statistical declarations (BE, FR & LUX)
• Managing intercompany netting processes and related tax implications.
• Ensuring compliance with indirect tax, customs, and cross-border transaction requirement
• Ensure accurate corporate tax provisions (ISOC)
• Oversee quarterly VAT calculations
• Management Report (PM)
• Corporate tax calculation, transfer pricing and client listings
• Support Pillar 2 compliance 

E-commerce Marketplace:

• Support tax projects and implement tax controls.
• Ensure compliance with DAC7, Deemed Supplier, and C2C requirements.
• Review and validate invoice flows.
• Support profit split analyses and related tax matters.
• Act as the main tax contact for the marketplace business.
• Coordinate with local tax specialists on international projects.
• Identify tax risks and support process improvements.

The ideal candidate matches the following criteria:

• Master's degree in Finance or Law, specialized in Tax / Fiscal sciences
• Fluent in English and good command of French or Dutch
• Strong expertise in corporate tax and indirect tax (VAT)
• Hands-on with proven ability to execute operational tax tasks
• Critical mindset, ability to analyse future impact of regulations on the business
• Experience in international and cross-border tax environments
• Ability to manage multiple compliance cycles (monthly, quarterly, annual)
• Strong communication skills for stakeholder and cross-country coordination

Are you an experienced Office Manager looking for a varied role in a fast-paced international environment? Our client is seeking an organized and proactive professional to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of their Brussels office while supporting business operations and employee experience.

 

Client Details

Our client is a growing international company active in the FMCG sector, known for developing and distributing innovative consumer products across European markets. With a strong focus on quality, sustainability, and collaboration, they have built a dynamic workplace where employees are encouraged to take initiative and contribute to the company's continued success. Their modern offices in Brussels serve as a key hub for their Benelux operations.

 

Description

As Office Manager, you will act as the central point of contact for all office-related matters and play a crucial role in maintaining an efficient and welcoming work environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing the daily operations and overall organization of the office.
• Coordinating suppliers, facility management partners, and external service providers.
• Ensuring office spaces are functional, well-maintained, and fully equipped.
• Organizing internal meetings, events, and company activities.
• Managing office budgets, invoices, and administrative processes.
• Supporting HR-related administration, including onboarding and employee documentation.
• Coordinating travel arrangements, accommodation bookings, and meeting logistics.
• Providing administrative support to the local leadership team.
• Acting as the first point of contact for visitors and external stakeholders.
• Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and office efficiency.

 

• You have previous experience in an Office Manager, Administrative Manager, Executive Assistant, or similar position.
• You can demonstrate a successful track record in a professional office environment.
• You have an excellent command of English combined with either French or Dutch.
• Knowledge of the third language (French or Dutch) is considered a strong asset.
• You are highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• You are hands-on, solution-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
• You have strong attention to detail and a professional approach.
• You are proficient with Microsoft Office and common administrative tools.

Our customer is an international company active in the healthcare industry (medical devices) having its European headquarters based in Zaventem.

Jobomschrijving

As Payroll & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for the full, accurate and timely management of the company's payroll administration for all employees, in full compliance with legal requirements and internal policies.
You play a central role in optimising payroll processes, with a strong affinity for Compensation & Benefits, and actively contribute to broader HR projects.

Key responsibilities:- Ensure the accurate execution of the monthly payroll cycle, including salary calculations, benefits, taxes and social security contributions.
- Deliver ad-hoc reporting and analytics, providing detailed insights into payroll costs, HR trends and other key performance indicators.
- Work closely with the external payroll provider (e.g. SD Worx) to guarantee a smooth and reliable payroll operation.
- Manage and continuously improve processes related to leave, absences and employee benefits (insurance plans, meal vouchers, etc.).
- Act as the primary point of contact for employees regarding payroll and benefits-related queries, with the ability to clearly explain payroll related processes.
- Actively contribute to HR projects, including initiatives aimed at improving payroll and compensation efficiency and the implementation of new HR tools or solutions.
- Ensure full compliance with social and tax legislation and promote best practices within the payroll function.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the following skills and experience:

- You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in a relevant field or equivalent by experience

- You can demonstrate more than 4 years of experience in payroll management. Any additional experience with the UK, Germany, or the Netherlands payroll systems is considered an asset.

- You have a very good knowledge of the Belgian social legislation

- You are fluent in English and Dutch (both written and spoken), knowledge of French is an asset.

- You possess good communication skills allowing you to clearly explain HR payroll related processes to varied stakeholders

- You are customer oriented, can handle confidential information with the necessary discretion and enjoy working within an international and multicultural environment
